### Encouragement for Today: I Picked Up a Runaway
Author: Holly Good
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-mar-10-2011.html
Passage: Jeremiah 50:6
Points:
- Encountering a wandering young runaway illustrates how easily people run away from home and safety when hurt or upset.
- Like lost sheep who have forgotten their resting place, people often wander while quietly hoping someone will rescue them.
- Running away from problems or relationships leaves a soul spiritually exhausted, lonely, and burdened.
- God's enduring love invites wanderers to stop running, return to Him, and rediscover their true resting place.
